Vertical 9:16 video. Animate this exact photograph, keeping every detail of the frame identical. Her thumb presses slowly into the brushed wool and the fibres compress under it, then release.

The bag never changes shape, colour or hardware: The tote from the second reference image, exactly as shown. Oatmeal brushed wool felt body, trapezoid tote wider at the top with a flat base, structured so it stands upright unaided. Exactly 2 handles, caramel leather along the upper arc and oatmeal wool down the legs, and those legs continue down the FRONT face as exactly 2 vertical wool straps. Exactly 1 caramel leather belt crosses the FRONT face behind both straps, its 2 ends curving down and outward into exactly 1 round gold disc cap each, 2 caps total and the only hardware outside. The mouth is a plain open rim of wool edge to edge. Every outer surface is blank wool and plain caramel leather, nothing printed or stamped anywhere on it.

Shot on an iPhone, handheld, slightly imperfect framing, mild sensor noise, real photograph. Not a 3D render, not CGI, no plastic skin, no glossy studio product sheen, no color grading. Soft daylight from a tall window out of frame at the LEFT, shadows falling gently to the right, low contrast, the wall behind her a stop darker than she is. Neutral daylight, slightly desaturated, lifted blacks.

No other people enter the frame. No text or captions appear. No music. No zoom transition, no speed change, no slow motion.

Vertical 9:16.
